scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @aether/extension run prepare && tsc --build --verbose && tsc -p apps/desktop/renderer/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm contrast && pnpm extension:build && tsc --build apps/cli apps/desktop && pnpm --filter @aether/desktop renderer:build && vitest run
scripts.codemode:test: pnpm --filter @aether/desktop build && pnpm --filter @aether/cli build && pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/tests/codemode-desktop.test.ts apps/cli/tests/command.test.ts --poolOptions.forks.maxForks=1 --poolOptions.forks.minForks=1
scripts.desktop: tsc --build apps/desktop && pnpm --filter @aether/desktop run renderer:build && node scripts/run-desktop.mjs
